name: Lord Melenas is up at Fel Rock and comes back after a kill (#8874)
contract: Twisted Hatred 932 asks for Melenas' Head 5221, which Lord Melenas 2038 drops at 100% for players on the quest. Melenas has three Fel Rock spawns (49818, 49819, 49850) in pool 387 with max_limit 1, so exactly one of them is up at a time, and each respawns 120 s after a kill at a pool-chosen spot. The player stands at a Fel Rock grell spawn (48025) that is within 50 yards of all three spots. Expected: one Melenas is up, killing and looting him completes the quest, and exactly one Melenas is up again within three minutes, at whichever spot the pool picks.

steps.label: SETUP: join the world phase Lord Melenas lives in

Drop the fixture head so the quest needs it again

DISCRIMINATING: exactly one Lord Melenas is up at Fel Rock
